parsed.reason: Description A says the retry loop catches all GatewayError subclasses, so permanent errors like CardDeclined are retried unnecessarily. Description B says that after retries are exhausted the function falls off the loop and returns None, which callers mistake for success. These are different failures: one is retrying non-transient errors, the other is the missing return/raise after exhaustion.
